messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: SEV2 PAGE - Elevated 5xx rate for customer Calyx (VPC: vpc-calyx-01) on dedicated pool calyx-prod-pool-a. Error rate spike started ~5112233400, 40% 5xx over rolling 5m. Paging oncall.

Maya Patel: on it, joining bridge. assigning to SRE Oncall for triage. please post quick impact summary.

SRE Oncall: joining — what's the symptom? 503s or 5xx from runtime?

IncidentBot: Most responses are 503/504 from the model runtime; http 500 from proxy layer as well. Error example: `{"error":"model-serve: instance exited with code 137"}`.

Ben Chu: I see repeated OOM kill logs from `model-worker` processes in calyx-prod-pool-a. nodes: gpu-node-42,gpu-node-43. Memory climbs until OOM then container dies and we drop requests -> proxy 503.

Rick Anders: confirmed. tailing logs:
```
[2026-03-15T10:03:12Z] model-worker[pid=1783] mem_usage=47.2GiB
[2026-03-15T10:03:15Z] model-worker[pid=1783] mem_usage=49.9GiB
[2026-03-15T10:03:17Z] kernel: cgroup out_of_memory: Kill process 1783 (model-worker)
```

Maya Patel: initial customer impact: all inference traffic to calyx-prod-pool-a fails for requests >512 tokens. Short prompts sometimes succeed. Calyx reports degraded latency and 20% failed calls in their dashboards. Lina, heads up for CS.

Lina Gomez: thanks. I'm preparing a holding message for Calyx. ETA for customer note?

Ben Chu: immediate mitigation plan: drain pool, isolate affected tenants, spin up isolated fallback pool with a smaller model variant, and enable throttling on long-context requests. Commands I'll run:
```
# mark pool as draining
redwoodctl pool set-state calyx-prod-pool-a --state=draining
# isolate the tenant from the affected pool
redwoodctl tenant isolate calyx --from-pool=calyx-prod-pool-a --to-pool=calyx-fallback-pool
# scale fallback pool
redwoodctl pool scale calyx-fallback-pool --gpus=4
```

DeployBot: Requested rollout: `isolate-tenant/calyx/5112233445` created. CI checks passed.

Rick Anders: quick note — the crash seems correlated with nightly model artifact `calyx-llama-alpha:v2026-03-14` which has different memory footprints (new attention kernels). If we fallback to `calyx-llama-alpha:v2026-03-10` memory stabilizes. Recommend serving previous model variant for Calyx while we root-cause.

Ben Chu: executing steps now. Will route new traffic to calyx-fallback-pool and pin variant to v2026-03-10.

Ben Chu: running:
```
redwoodctl route set calyx --pool=calyx-fallback-pool --model=calyx-llama-alpha:v2026-03-10 --migrate=true
```

Maya Patel: SRE Oncall, can you validate KV cache state and ensure we don't flood backend with cold cache? Consider enabling short-term request queueing and slow-start.

SRE Oncall: on it. Enabling short-term prefix caching and adding a qps cap: `redwoodctl quota set calyx --qps=80 --burst=200`

Ben Chu: pool drained successfully on gpu-node-42,43. No further OOMs observed on fallback pool after routing. Early signal: 5xx down from 40% -> 4%.

Lina Gomez: drafting customer update: "We've detected elevated errors affecting long-context requests in your dedicated pool. We've routed your traffic to an isolated fallback pool with a stable model variant to restore service. We're continuing to investigate and will follow up with an RCA and proposed credits." Want me to send now as a brief or wait for full blameless summary?

Maya Patel: send a brief notice now (holding wording). They care about mitigation and ETA. Add apology and that we're prioritizing an RCA. Lina, offer a post-incident call with execs.

Lina Gomez: posted to Calyx Slack (private):
> We routed traffic to an isolated pool and rolled back the model variant to restore calls. Some in-flight requests may have failed during the switchover. We will follow up with root-cause analysis and credits if SLA impacted.

IncidentBot: :white_check_mark: Mitigation applied — routing changed at 5112233521. Monitoring for error rate regression.

Ben Chu: observed transient increased latency while caches warm but 5xx stabilized to ~1.5%. Keeping throttles for long requests.

Rick Anders: next steps for engineering: reproduce locally with artifact v2026-03-14, run memory profiler on attention kernels. Early suspicion: an edge-case in recent attention rewrite leads to unexpected allocation for sequences >1024 when using quantized kernels.

Maya Patel: Ops actions: open ticket to rollback v2026-03-14 across other dedicated pools pending root-cause. We'll keep Calyx pinned to v2026-03-10 until cleared.

Ben Chu: creating mitigation runbook notes in incident doc. excerpt:
```
- detect: OOM pattern in model-worker
- mitigate: drain pool, isolate tenant, route to fallback, pin model variant
- short-term: apply qps caps, slow-start traffic
- long-term: fix memory leak in attention kernel, add OOM alarm threshold
```

Lina Gomez: For customer comms — propose 15% service credit on next invoice as a gesture if RCA shows we missed SLA for >60 mins. Want approval from ops lead / finance.

Maya Patel: approve provisional credit proposal, pending RCA. Ops lead, please confirm with finance.

Rick Anders: engineering will own root cause. I'll lead kernel-level debugging. Need perf traces for gpu-node-42 at crash window. Ben can you attach core dump and perf traces to the ticket?

Ben Chu: attaching artifacts: `s3://redwood-logs/calyx/5112233445/gpu-node-42-core.tgz` and perf traces uploaded.

SRE Oncall: recommending follow-ups:\n- RCA draft by EOD UTC+0 (owner: Rick Anders)\n- Exec brief for Calyx (one pager) by Lina — include timeline, impact, credits, next steps\n- Postmortem ticket to assign remediation tasks and track cross-team work

Maya Patel: handoff to follow-up owners. I'm stepping off bridge at 5112233590 — if anything regresses please page oncall.

Lina Gomez: I'll schedule a post-incident call with Calyx CSM + their CTO. Drafting exec note now, will share here for review.

Rick Anders: RCA draft — initial hypothesis: memory growth triggered by attention kernel path when sequence length >1024 with quantization flags set. Steps to reproduce and test added to doc. Will submit draft in thread by 5112233620.

IncidentBot: Incident status -> mitigated. Severity remains SEV2 until RCA and credits discussed.

Maya Patel: thank you team. short action items:\n- Rick: RCA draft (owner)\n- Ben: attach artifacts and confirm no other pools using v2026-03-14 (owner)\n- Lina: customer exec note + credit proposal (owner)\n- SRE Oncall: monitor for 24h and watch error rate regressions

Ben Chu: confirmed no other dedicated pools running v2026-03-14. I'll start a CI test suite to replicate at scale.

Lina Gomez: posted draft exec note to thread for review: "Brief timeline, mitigation summary, customer impact (approx 55 minutes elevated errors for long-context requests), proposed 15% credit. Request approval to send in 1 hour."

Rick Anders: dropped RCA draft link: `https://redwood.internal/rca/5112233445` — summary included and reproduction steps.

Maya Patel: closing bridge. we'll transition to async post-incident comms. If any regressions -> re-open paging. :white_check_mark:

SRE Oncall: monitoring continues. last update: 5xx steady at <1%.
